_readme: Which never-executing branches an ARCHIVE mutation can reach. Reaching a check is not validating it: this shows an input exists that runs the line and that the executor refuses, not that the refusal is correct.
_targets_note: targets_pinned is the population this measurement was FIRST made against. `targets` is what the audit reports today, which this tool changes by being in the suite -- so the two differ by design and the pinned one is the denominator to quote.
